test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following won a gold medal for India in Boxing in the 2018 Commonwealth Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vikas Krishan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vikas Krishan Yadav** is an Indian boxer from **Haryana's Bhiwani area**, which is home to some of the country's top boxers.
 
• At the** 2010 Asian Games**, he earned a** gold medal **in the **Lightweight category.**
 
• Vikas won a **gold medal** in the **2018 Commonwealth Games** in Australia.
 
• He became the **first Indian male boxer **to win gold medals at both Asian and commonwealth games.
 
• In the **Asian games 2018, **he won **bronze**. He had to withdraw from further fights because of a serious eye injury.
 
• Vikas Krishan Yadav is the **second Indian boxer** to qualify for the Olympics for the** third time,** following Olympian Vijender Singh.
 
• He has been awarded **Best Boxer,** National Championships, New Delhi in 2010, and **Arjuna Award** in 2012.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Naman Tanwar**__:

 __
 
• Naman Tanwar is an **Indian boxer **who began his career in **Bheem Stadium, Haryana**, under the tutelage of **Vishnu Bhagwan** (Coach).
 
• In the Commonwealth Games in Gold Coast, Queensland, he earned a** bronze medal.**​
 
 
 
• **Manish Kaushik__:**
 
 
• Subedar Manish Kaushik is an **Indian boxer **who competes in the **lightweight division. **
 
• He is a **Junior Commissioned Officer** in the Indian Army (JCO).
 
• In his **maiden international debut**, Kaushik won the **gold medal **at the **Doha International Boxing Tournament.**
 
• At the **2017 National Boxing Games**, Manish earned gold.
 
• Manish Kaushik went on to earn a** silver medal **for India at the **2018 Commonwealth Games. **
 
• He represented India in the lightweight division at the **2020 Summer Olympics.**
